entries.title: Psalms 119:1
segments: ¶ALEPH. Blessed are the perfect in the way, who walk in the law of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 119:2
segments: Blessed are they that observe his testimonies, that seek him with the whole heart;

entries.title: Psalms 119:3
segments: Who also do no unrighteousness: they walk in his ways.

entries.title: Psalms 119:4
segments: ¶Thou hast enjoined thy precepts, to be kept diligently.

entries.title: Psalms 119:5
segments: Oh that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

entries.title: Psalms 119:6
segments: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:7
segments: ¶I will give thee thanks with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:8
segments: I will keep thy statutes: forsake me not utterly.

entries.title: Psalms 119:9
segments: ¶BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his path? by taking heed according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:10
segments: ¶With my whole heart have I sought thee: let me not wander from thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:11
segments: ¶Thy *word have I hid in my heart, that I might not sin against thee.

entries.title: Psalms 119:12
segments: ¶Blessed art thou, Jehovah! teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:13
segments: ¶With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:14
segments: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as [much as] in all wealth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:15
segments: I will meditate upon thy precepts, and have respect unto thy paths.

entries.title: Psalms 119:16
segments: I delight myself in thy statutes; I will not forget thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:17
segments: ¶GIMEL. Deal bountifully with thy servant [and] I shall live; and I will keep thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:18
segments: ¶Open mine eyes, and I shall behold wondrous things out of thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:19
segments: ¶I am a stranger in the land; hide not thy commandments from me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:20
segments: ¶My soul breaketh for longing after thy judgments at all times.

entries.title: Psalms 119:21
segments: ¶Thou hast rebuked the proud [that are] cursed, who wander from thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:22
segments: ¶Roll off from me reproach and contempt; for I observe thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:23
segments: ¶Princes also did sit [and] talk together against me: thy servant doth meditate in thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:24
segments: ¶Thy testimonies also are my delight [and] my counsellors.

entries.title: Psalms 119:25
segments: ¶DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken me according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:26
segments: ¶I have declared my ways, and thou hast answered me: teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:27
segments: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts, and I will meditate upon thy wondrous works.

entries.title: Psalms 119:28
segments: ¶My soul melteth for sadness: strengthen me according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:29
segments: Remove from me the way of falsehood, and graciously grant me thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:30
segments: ¶I have chosen the way of faithfulness; thy judgments have I set [before me].

entries.title: Psalms 119:31
segments: I cleave unto thy testimonies; Jehovah, let me not be ashamed.

entries.title: Psalms 119:32
segments: I will run the way of thy commandments when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:33
segments: ¶HE. Teach me, O Jehovah, the way of thy statutes, and I will observe it [unto] the end.

entries.title: Psalms 119:34
segments: Give me understanding, and I will observe thy law; and I will keep it with [my] whole heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:35
segments: ¶Make me to walk in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:36
segments: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to gain.

entries.title: Psalms 119:37
segments: ¶Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; quicken me in thy way.

entries.title: Psalms 119:38
segments: ¶Establish thy *word unto thy servant, who is [devoted] to thy fear.

entries.title: Psalms 119:39
segments: ¶Turn away my reproach which I fear; for thy judgments are good.

entries.title: Psalms 119:40
segments: ¶Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:41
segments: ¶VAU. And let thy loving-kindness come unto me, O Jehovah, --thy salvation according to thy *word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:42
segments: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me; for I confide in thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:43
segments: ¶And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; because I have hoped in thy judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:44
segments: Then will I keep thy law continually, for ever and ever;

entries.title: Psalms 119:45
segments: ¶And I will walk at liberty, for I have sought thy precepts;

entries.title: Psalms 119:46
segments: And I will speak of thy testimonies before kings, and will not be ashamed;

entries.title: Psalms 119:47
segments: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved;

entries.title: Psalms 119:48
segments: And I will lift up my hands unto thy commandments, which I have loved, and I will meditate in thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:49
segments: ¶ZAIN. Remember the word for thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

entries.title: Psalms 119:50
segments: ¶This is my comfort in mine affliction; for thy *word hath quickened me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:51
segments: ¶The proud have derided me beyond measure: I have not declined from thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:52
segments: ¶I remembered thy judgments of old, O Jehovah, and have comforted myself.

entries.title: Psalms 119:53
segments: ¶Burning indignation hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked who forsake thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:54
segments: ¶Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

entries.title: Psalms 119:55
segments: ¶I have remembered thy name, O Jehovah, in the night, and have kept thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:56
segments: This I have had, because I have observed thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:57
segments: ¶CHETH. My portion, O Jehovah, I have said, is to keep thy words.

entries.title: Psalms 119:58
segments: ¶I have sought thy favour with [my] whole heart: be gracious unto me according to thy *word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:59
segments: ¶I have thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:60
segments: I have made haste, and not delayed, to keep thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:61
segments: ¶The bands of the wicked have wrapped me round: I have not forgotten thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:62
segments: ¶At midnight I rise up to give thanks unto thee, because of thy righteous judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:63
segments: ¶I am the companion of all that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:64
segments: ¶The earth, O Jehovah, is full of thy loving-kindness: teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:65
segments: ¶TETH. Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Jehovah, according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:66
segments: Teach me good discernment and knowledge; for I have believed in thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:67
segments: ¶Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I keep thy *word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:68
segments: ¶Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:69
segments: ¶The proud have forged falsehood against me: I will observe thy precepts with [my] whole heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:70
segments: Their heart is as fat as grease: as for me, I delight in thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:71
segments: ¶It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I might learn thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:72
segments: ¶The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

entries.title: Psalms 119:73
segments: ¶YOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, and I will learn thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:74
segments: ¶They that fear thee will see me, and rejoice; because I have hoped in thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:75
segments: ¶I know, Jehovah, that thy Judgments are righteousness, and that in faithfulness thou hast afflicted me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:76
segments: ¶Oh let thy loving-kindness be for my comfort, according to thy *word unto thy servant.

entries.title: Psalms 119:77
segments: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; for thy law is my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:78
segments: ¶Let the proud be ashamed; for they have acted perversely towards me with falsehood: as for me, I meditate in thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:79
segments: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that know thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:80
segments: ¶Let my heart be perfect in thy statutes, that I be not ashamed.

entries.title: Psalms 119:81
segments: ¶CAPH. My soul fainteth for thy salvation; I hope in thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:82
segments: Mine eyes fail for thy *word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

entries.title: Psalms 119:83
segments: ¶For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; I do not forget thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:84
segments: ¶How many shall be the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

entries.title: Psalms 119:85
segments: ¶The proud have digged pits for me, which is not according to thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:86
segments: All thy commandments are faithfulness. They persecute me wrongfully: help thou me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:87
segments: They had almost consumed me upon the earth; but as for me, I forsook not thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:88
segments: ¶Quicken me according to thy loving-kindness, and I will keep the testimony of thy mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:89
segments: ¶LAMED. For ever, O Jehovah, thy word is settled in the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 119:90
segments: Thy faithfulness is from generation to generation: thou hast established the earth, and it standeth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:91
segments: By thine ordinances they stand this day; for all things are thy servants.

entries.title: Psalms 119:92
segments: ¶Unless thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

entries.title: Psalms 119:93
segments: ¶I will never forget thy precepts; for by them thou hast quickened me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:94
segments: ¶I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:95
segments: ¶The wicked have awaited me to destroy me; [but] I attend unto thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:96
segments: ¶I have seen an end of all perfection: thy commandment is exceeding broad.

entries.title: Psalms 119:97
segments: ¶MEM. Oh how I love thy law! it is my meditation all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 119:98
segments: ¶Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies; for they are ever with me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:99
segments: I have more understanding than all my teachers; for thy testimonies are my meditation.

entries.title: Psalms 119:100
segments: I understand more than the aged, because I have observed thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:101
segments: ¶I have refrained my feet from every evil path, that I might keep thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:102
segments: ¶I have not departed from thy judgments; for it is thou that hast taught me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:103
segments: ¶How sweet are thy *words unto my taste! more than honey to my mouth!

entries.title: Psalms 119:104
segments: From thy precepts I get understanding; therefore I hate every false path.

entries.title: Psalms 119:105
segments: ¶NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

entries.title: Psalms 119:106
segments: ¶I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:107
segments: ¶I am afflicted very much; O Jehovah, quicken me according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:108
segments: ¶Accept, I beseech thee, Jehovah, the voluntary-offerings of my mouth, and teach me thy judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:109
segments: ¶My life is continually in my hand; but I do not forget thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:110
segments: The wicked have laid a snare for me; but I have not wandered from thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:111
segments: ¶Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:112
segments: I have inclined my heart to perform thy statutes for ever, unto the end.

entries.title: Psalms 119:113
segments: ¶SAMECH. The double-minded have I hated; but thy law do I love.

entries.title: Psalms 119:114
segments: ¶Thou art my hiding-place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:115
segments: ¶Depart from me, ye evil-doers; and I will observe the commandments of my God.

entries.title: Psalms 119:116
segments: ¶Uphold me according to thy *word, that I may live; and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

entries.title: Psalms 119:117
segments: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe; and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

entries.title: Psalms 119:118
segments: ¶Thou hast set at nought all them that wander from thy statutes; for their deceit is falsehood.

entries.title: Psalms 119:119
segments: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth [like] dross; therefore I love thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:120
segments: My flesh shuddereth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:121
segments: ¶AIN. I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

entries.title: Psalms 119:122
segments: Be surety for thy servant for good; let not the proud oppress me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:123
segments: ¶Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the *word of thy righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:124
segments: ¶Deal with thy servant according to thy loving-kindness, and teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:125
segments: I am thy servant; give me understanding that I may know thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:126
segments: ¶It is time for Jehovah to work: they have made void thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:127
segments: ¶Therefore I love thy commandments above gold, yea, above fine gold.

entries.title: Psalms 119:128
segments: Therefore I regard all [thy] precepts concerning all things to be right: I hate every false path.

entries.title: Psalms 119:129
segments: ¶PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful; therefore doth my soul observe them.

entries.title: Psalms 119:130
segments: ¶The entrance of thy words giveth light, giving understanding unto the simple.

entries.title: Psalms 119:131
segments: ¶I opened my mouth wide and panted; for I longed for thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:132
segments: ¶Turn unto me, and be gracious unto me, as thou art wont to do unto those that love thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 119:133
segments: ¶Establish my steps in thy *word; and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:134
segments: ¶Deliver me from the oppression of man; and I will keep thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:135
segments: ¶Make thy face to shine upon thy servant, and teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:136
segments: ¶Mine eyes run down with streams of water, because they keep not thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:137
segments: ¶TZADE. Righteous art thou, Jehovah, and upright are thy judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:138
segments: Thou hast commanded thy testimonies in righteousness and exceeding faithfulness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:139
segments: ¶My zeal destroyeth me, because mine oppressors have forgotten thy words.

entries.title: Psalms 119:140
segments: ¶Thy *word is exceeding pure, and thy servant loveth it.

entries.title: Psalms 119:141
segments: ¶I am little and despised: thy precepts have I not forgotten.

entries.title: Psalms 119:142
segments: ¶Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is truth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:143
segments: ¶Trouble and anguish have taken hold upon me: thy commandments are my delights.

entries.title: Psalms 119:144
segments: The righteousness of thy testimonies is for ever: give me understanding, and I shall live.

entries.title: Psalms 119:145
segments: ¶KOPH. I have called with [my] whole heart; answer me, O Jehovah: I will observe thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:146
segments: I call upon thee; save me, and I will keep thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:147
segments: ¶I anticipate the morning-dawn and I cry: I hope in thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:148
segments: Mine eyes anticipate the night-watches, that I may meditate in thy *word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:149
segments: ¶Hear my voice according to thy loving-kindness: O Jehovah, quicken me according to thy judgment.

entries.title: Psalms 119:150
segments: ¶They have drawn nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:151
segments: Thou, Jehovah, art near, and all thy commandments are truth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:152
segments: ¶From thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:153
segments: ¶RESH. See mine affliction, and deliver me; for I have not forgotten thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:154
segments: Plead my cause, and redeem me: quicken me according to thy *word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:155
segments: ¶Salvation is far from the wicked; for they seek not thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:156
segments: ¶Many are thy tender mercies, O Jehovah; quicken me according to thy judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:157
segments: ¶Many are my persecutors and mine oppressors; I have not declined from thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:158
segments: ¶I beheld them that deal treacherously, and was grieved; because they kept not thy *word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:159
segments: ¶See how I have loved thy precepts: quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thy loving-kindness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:160
segments: ¶The sum of thy word is truth, and every righteous judgment of thine is for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:161
segments: ¶SHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause; but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:162
segments: ¶I have joy in thy *word, as one that findeth great spoil.

entries.title: Psalms 119:163
segments: ¶I hate and abhor falsehood; thy law do I love.

entries.title: Psalms 119:164
segments: ¶Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:165
segments: ¶Great peace have they that love thy law, and nothing doth stumble them.

entries.title: Psalms 119:166
segments: ¶I have hoped for thy salvation, O Jehovah, and have done thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:167
segments: ¶My soul hath kept thy testimonies, and I love them exceedingly.

entries.title: Psalms 119:168
segments: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies; for all my ways are before thee.

entries.title: Psalms 119:169
segments: ¶TAU. Let my cry come near before thee, Jehovah: give me understanding according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:170
segments: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy *word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:171
segments: ¶My lips shall pour forth praise when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:172
segments: ¶My tongue shall speak aloud of thy *word; for all thy commandments are righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:173
segments: ¶Let thy hand be for my help; for I have chosen thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:174
segments: I have longed for thy salvation, O Jehovah, and thy law is my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:175
segments: ¶Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:176
segments: ¶I have gone astray like a lost sheep: seek thy servant; for I have not forgotten thy commandments.
